set.body:
Source: upper-layer Site/pilot design review and the existing unused-epoch finding.

Problem:
SubmissionUnavailable is a permanent dead end and no command increments AttemptEpoch. Rolling replacement needs a truthful resubmit-under-one-durable-intent primitive, but AcceptanceUnknown must never be retried blindly.

Scope and acceptance:
- Add an explicit retry/resubmit command with caller-supplied authorization and reason.
- Reject AcceptanceUnknown and any phase where prior scheduler acceptance remains possible.
- Atomically bump epoch, create the new submit outbox entry, reset execution-local observation/accounting/cancellation state, and retain prior bindings/history.
- Fence old scheduler, worker, event, and result evidence by epoch.
- Move retry-safety provenance into the neutral pre-execution core and persist it in canonical intent, task invocation, and durable result handle; a result envelope may mirror but never originate authorization.
- Distinguish new sbatch resubmission from Slurm's in-place requeue operation.
- Add transition, journal replay, cancellation-injection, and stale-result tests.
set.title: P6f.24: Add explicit epoch-fenced managed resubmission
